scope: All 448 already registered R1B daily-screen paths, separate development and validation accounts; no new strategy, holdout access, candidate selection or confirmatory family.
method_findings: Main arithmetic paired-return mean, initial-cash first-day return, HAC-studentized null-centered block bootstrap and unknown-hurdle gating match protocol.
Same dates and seed implicitly synchronize bootstrap blocks within a period. Between periods no common dates exist; separate samples are appropriate.
Evaluator requires identical calendars across runs and all sample years, but not exact equality to admitted exchange sessions. Independent review will check exact funded-session lists.

Evaluator verifies cash/receivable/position-value arithmetic, but does not independently reconstruct units from fills and corporate actions. Independent inventory check will supplement this limitation.
Rank contrasts are explicit. Independent report will also show trend, scaling and interaction diagnostics already implied by the frozen factorial ablations, descriptively only.
Formal p=1 values are not-ready placeholders, not test results. Zero-hurdle diagnostics remain exploratory and unadjusted; annual incremental fixed cost is not set to zero for economic claims.
planned_integrity_checks: Exact admitted manifest hashes and source/table file hashes.
Exact registered configuration inventory including retained failures and no unregistered successful attempts.
Preregistration timestamp precedes first local run registration; local chronology does not authenticate an external timestamp.
Every funded session present exactly once; fresh 2016/2022 account; no 2025 price/account data.
Every daily position quantity reconstructed from fills and correctly phased share events, aggregate rounding and no negative units.
Raw close and EOD conversion mark checks, dividend entitlement and modeled cash timing where actual ledgers permit.
All annual contribution sums and calendar-year compounded returns reconcile to total return.
First-day return and drawdown include initial cash; fees/slippage never deducted twice.
Complete base, cost2/3, slip0, D+3 execution and cash+1/+3 stress outcomes retained for every capital and variant.
planned_descriptive_diagnostics: All R0-E0, R1-E1, E1-E0, R1-R0 matched daily differences by period, capital, scaling and stress.
Scaling-on minus scaling-off for each matched variant; trend-by-ranking interaction (R1-R0)-(E1-E0); no added p-values.
100k base primary capital emphasis; all other capitals implementation robustness, no best-capital selection.
Year contributions and fixed trailing 252-session mean paired increments where available; no selected date cutoffs.
Zero-cash-target Sortino, Calmar, worst calendar month and daily lower-tail 5-percent expected shortfall; diagnostic definitions disclosed.
HAC long-run-variance Sharpe diagnostic and lag1 return autocorrelation alongside conventional 252 annualization.
Exposure, cash, concentration, turnover, fills, rejections and stale marks used to qualify trend/scaling utility.
Signed endpoint-equivalent annual incremental cost 100000*252*mean(daily difference) is arithmetic sensitivity only, not an observed cost quote or economic confirmation.
unchanged_limitations: Current corrected data vintage; no original vendor first-seen evidence.
D039 anchor D, decision D+1 at21, execution D+2; all matched variants use same release.
Rule-based hypothetical cash receipt; actual investor receipt unknown.
Daily opening simulation does not verify minute liquidity or queues.
No factor-alpha or independent-skill claim; no factor return series.
Validation2022-24 is not final holdout; final2025-26 remains locked.
Unknown incremental operating cost leaves BLOCKED_HURDLE.
